messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the Canadian statutory holidays that create long‑weekends in 2023 (dates are given in the local time zone for each holiday).  These are the holidays that most people observe nationwide; provincial holidays that create extra long‑weekends are listed separately at the end.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday, Jan 1 | Dec 31 – Jan 2 (includes the weekend) |
| **Good Friday** | Friday, Apr 7 | Apr 7 – 9 (Fri‑Sun) |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday, May 22 | May 20 – 22 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday, Jul 1 | Jun 30 – Jul 2 (Fri‑Mon) |
| **Labour Day** | Monday, Sep 4 | Sep 2 – 4 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday, Oct 9 | Oct 7 – 9 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Remembrance Day** | Monday, Nov 11 | Nov 9 – 11 (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday, Dec 25 | Dec 23 – 25 (Sat‑Mon) |

> **Note:** Boxing Day falls on Tuesday, Dec 26, 2023, so it does not create a long‑weekend on its own.

### Provincial holidays that also create long‑weekends (examples)

| Province | Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|----------|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| Ontario | Family Day | Monday, Feb 20 | Feb 18 – 20 |
| British Columbia | Family Day | Monday, Feb 20 | Feb 18 – 20 |
| Alberta | Family Day | Monday, Feb 20 | Feb 18 – 20 |
| Saskatchewan | Family Day | Monday, Feb 20 | Feb 18 – 20 |
| Manitoba | Louis Riel Day | Monday, Feb 20 | Feb 18 – 20 |
| Quebec | Saint‑Joseph’s Day | Monday, Mar 27 | Mar 25 – 27 |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | St. Patrick’s Day | Monday, Mar 20 | Mar 18 – 20 |
| ... | ... | ... | ... |

If you need the full list of provincial holidays for a specific province or territory, let me know and I can pull those details for you.
